name: expandable-card
title: Expandable Card
description: A compact list of titled items with thumbnails and a Play button. Clicking a row animates it into a large centred card with a big cover image, a green call to action and scrollable detail text, over a blurred backdrop.
use: A compact list of media or products should reveal a richer image-and-copy card without leaving the page.
avoid: The morph needs a tall viewport and locks page scroll; long detail text is clipped into a short scroll area.
a11y: Rows are clickable divs that cannot be focused, so keyboard users cannot open a card; the modal has no dialog role and no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A short dark list of four rows, each with a small square thumbnail, a title and a grey name line, and a rounded Play pill at the far right. Clicking one grows it into a centred dark card with a tall cover photo, a bold title and subtitle, a green Play pill and a block of small grey copy.
behaves: Clicking a row morphs it in place into the modal card while the other rows blur behind a dark overlay, the thumbnail growing into the cover image. Hovering a row highlights it and turns its Play pill green; Escape, an outside click or the close button returns to the list.
customise: Cards come as an array of title, description, image src, CTA text and link, plus a content node; a variant switches between compact list and two-column grid.
weight: light: Four list rows and four images with one shared-layout animation on open.
